domain.allDenominatorsPositive: Original source 0<h,lambda<1/16, X0>0, s>=1/2 and1-2h eta^2>7/8. All mu_p>0. Distinct fixed geometric angular nodes and1-exp(-2lambda/5)>0 are retained.
domain.sourceSupportPremise: The authenticated original reserved Imean is strictly inside(Xa,Xb). Only its separated compact subcollar is used for the zeta inverse.
domain.primitiveSupportProof: The exact homogeneous axial moment row and change of variables x=exp(j/5)y imply the full weighted profile integral is zero. The forward primitive is zero before the first support and after the last support. Its entire hull remains inside the same Imean collar; no raw full moment integral is discarded numerically.

naturalSeriesKernel.meaning: Limit of the exact generated radial coefficient partial sums. Each finite partial sum is a complete A.21/g expression graph. The explicit B_rho tail tends to zero.

expressionKernel.meaning: Shared explicit expression bodies with mixed automatic differentiation. Every requested jet is a derivative of the retained actual body, never a caller-supplied coefficient.

picardKernel.etaDerivativeImplementation: actual_background_picard with the exact derivative partial sums and Cauchy tail

seed.flatness: For every fixed n,N, exp(1/q)>=(1/q)^(N+2n+1)/(N+2n+1)! gives |D^n seed|<=||P_n||_1*(N+2n+1)!*q^(N+1). Thus every derivative tends to0 at both endpoints and the zero extension is C-infinity.
